claim: On Dec. 17, 1903 at Kitty Hawk, Orville Wright made the first powered flight: 12 seconds, 120 feet; Wilbur's fourth flight that day lasted 59 seconds and covered 852 feet.

beats.caption: DEC. 17, 1903
beats.vo: December 17th, 1903, Kitty Hawk, North Carolina. Orville and Wilbur Wright ready their Flyer.

beats.caption: 10:35 A.M.
beats.vo: At 10:35 a.m., Orville lifts off. Twelve seconds. One hundred twenty feet.

beats.caption: FOUR FLIGHTS
beats.vo: Three more flights follow that day, the brothers taking turns.

beats.caption: 59 SECONDS
beats.vo: The last one, flown by Wilbur, lasts fifty-nine seconds and covers eight hundred fifty-two feet. The aerial age has begun.
